quest.title: Riddle me This...
quest.description: With the "ever-helpful" suggestions of the Acolyte bouncing around your head, you set off to locate one of these enigmatic Wordstones of the Goddess. It still amazes me that nobody knew, at the time, the true extent of these stones powers. But that, of course, is another tale...

node.instruction: Solve the riddle of the Stone
node.journal_entry: The light seemed to galvanize the stone before you. Blazing sigils appeared and erupted in bursts of luminescence that, I would assume, burned themselves into your retinas even after you closed your eyes!

task.task_instruction: A full set of Chain Mail Armor
A full set of Padded Leather Armor

node.instruction: Seek out and interact with one of the ancient and enigmatic $[Resource.Q.r_qt_wordstone_NamePlural].
node.journal_entry: As you approached the large, ancient Monolith, it was clear that before you stood a thing of considerable power. Almost as if sensing your presence it began to hum with a primal force that reached right into your core, resonating within the deepest recesses of your mind.
"Shed on situations, the first to be seen, needed by sight, required to gleam."
And then...the voice faded away, leaving your skull raw and battered. It seemed clear that you would likely need to solve this riddle should you wish to access the power of the stone.

Suddenly, you were reeling as pure knowledge pulsed right into your memory! Images were born and exploded in your mind's eye. Agon, eons ago, young and prosperous, watched over by the loving eye of its mother, the Goddess. You watched as a group of powerful mortals, the Usurpers, stormed her halls and cast her out, taking her place as the gods of Agon. The skies flashed through your vision as centuries of strife and struggle for dominion continued to stream by.

action.tag: wordstone activated sfx

node.journal_entry: Certain events occasionally flickered upwards out of the maelstrom of imagery, visual milestones in the flood of history. Ur Khamset the Usurper ensures his immortality by cursing the life force of Rubaiyat. The titanic Nithron, a race of golden giants, suddenly disappear, leaving behind a suddenly liberated servant-race of elves. A giant being, a primal behemoth from a forgotten time, wipes out the civilization of the Ithwen.

An order of scholars emerges, blessed with immortality by their patron. The Acolytes of the Watcher are tasked with gathering history and lore to be used by their mysterious benefactor at the time of "the reckoning".
And finally, you watch as the Watcher reveals herself to be the Goddess, judging her children as unfit to rule Agon, bringing her celestial armies to cleanse Agon of the mortal blight.

node.instruction: Seek out an Acolyte of the Watcher.
node.journal_entry: The acolyte, wordlessly handed you some more protective gear from the towns stockpile. Your eyes held fresh knowledge, a dangerous gleam of wisdom that spoke of the trials ahead of you.
You reached out, brushing your hand over the surface of the ancient monolith and suddenly a voice akin to the shifting of continents pulsed, almost unbearably, inside your skull.
That, or the Acolyte was just in that habit of handing out armor to passing strangers!
